CONSTRUCTION AT A GLANCE

Four details for your next training collection.

Scalloped side openings

Curved hems provide leg clearance for squats, lunges and kicking drills. Check movement and coverage on the fit sample.

Pin-dot mesh inner layer

Visible perforated mesh introduces a ventilation-focused inner construction. Review coverage and contact comfort.

Adjustable elastic waist

The gathered waistband and white drawcord offer an adjustable starting point; confirm retention and elastic recovery.

Rear yoke & minimal identity

Panelled rear construction, clean white lettering and front marks support a restrained private-label collection.

Specifications & sample approval

Core Stealth custom shorts development reference
Outer shellLightweight four-way-stretch woven direction from the supplied brief. Exact fiber ratio and GSM confirmed by swatch.
Inner layerPin-dot stretch mesh. Confirm coverage, composition and fit on the sample.
WaistbandGathered elastic waist with adjustable white contrast drawcord.
CutAbove-knee athletic silhouette with deep scalloped side openings; dimensions and slit depth by approval.
Rear constructionContoured rear yoke panel with white TONTON lettering.
BrandingFront leg marks and rear lettering; agree transfer, silicone or other suitable decoration method.
Private label optionsColors, artwork, length, liner, waistband, size chart, labels and packaging.
Care directionCold gentle wash inside out with like colors; hang dry preferred. Confirm final care label for the selected fabric and decoration.

OEM / ODM PROCUREMENT

From your brief to a repeatable specification.

Send the project brief

Share quantity, sizes, destination, target date, logo and construction requirements. Final production artwork is not required to start.

Approve the sample

Confirm shell and mesh, waist recovery, drawcord, scallop depth, measurements, branding and packing. Retain the approved sample and artwork for reorders.

Selected projects from 10 pieces; minimums per style and colorway, sample costs, schedule and shipping basis are confirmed in your quote.

Training shorts fabric & ventilation guide · Quality inspection checklist · Repeat-customer project

Custom scallop training shorts: buyer questions

Is this a full compression-lined short?

The supplied images show pin-dot mesh beneath the shell. Confirm its coverage and fit on the sample; a full compression layer must be specified separately.

Can I customize the logo and fit?

Yes. Discuss branding positions, color, scallop depth, length, waistband, liner and private-label finishing during development.

What is the exact material composition?

Fiber percentages and GSM have not been confirmed for this reference. Record them from the selected production swatch and approved specification.

Which activities suit this reference?

Use it as a starting point for gym, running, functional training and combat-sport conditioning. For MMA or no-gi BJJ competition, separately confirm event requirements, drawcord security and the selected construction.

What are the MOQ and sample conditions?

Selected custom projects commonly start from 10 pieces, subject to construction and material availability. Confirm quantities per style and colorway. The 3–7 day sampling target starts after details and artwork are agreed; sourcing and revisions can extend it.

How do I approve performance and care requirements?

Specify any required drying, abrasion, water-repellency, seam-strength or decoration-wash tests for the actual fabric and sample. Follow the final approved garment care label.
